title: Alexandra Fullbody - Boostcamp Edition nov 2026
author: Mario
desc:
Tips:
Perform 1 or preferably 2 warming up sets with every exercise ( you can do them in " superset" style directly after a other exercise).
1st warming up set with 30%
2st warming up set with 60%

Start lowest comfortable weight where you can easily do the amount of reps with having like 4 reps in the tank

Do "supersets"   like squats alternated with chest press.  Or crunches with cable rows, you can use the exercise order for this.

ex.note: Warm-up before the workout.

ss.note: Perform 1, preferably 2 warm-up sets: first at 30%, second at 60% (percentage basis and warm-up reps not specified). Start with a comfortable weight, about 4 reps in reserve. Warm-up sets are additional to the listed working sets. Alternate exercises within superset A.
